findings.scope: historically evaluated source official test, common original optical coverage, means of3 seeds
findings.meaning: Promising point-context mechanism; source roof-retention differs and target roof accuracy remains unknown
Gate output barely changes under this proxy shift. Three initialization seeds do not establish a statistical significance result
The99.5% value is a calibration target on source validation, not a certified test or US guarantee
Proxy donor shifts are not real temporal canopy change; no temporal-change solution is established

recommendation: Prioritize a separately validated model of observation reliability/roof preservation before adding a more elaborate gate; obtain independent DC roof/tree labels and multiple source spatial splits before accuracy claims
not_a_model_selection_rule: These test results are reported as findings; this round fixed every model and reconstruction seed before observing them
